items.title: New EDR-Redir Tool Breaks EDR Exploiting Bind Filter and Cloud Filter Driver
items.description: A new tool called EDR-Redir has emerged, allowing attackers to redirect or isolate the executable folders of popular Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) solutions. Demonstrated by cybersecurity researcher TwoSevenOneT, the technique leverages Windows’ Bind Filter driver (bindflt.sys) and Cloud Filter driver (cldflt.sys) to undermine EDR protections without requiring kernel-level access. items.title: New CoPhish Attack Exploits Copilot Studio to Exfiltrate OAuth Tokens
items.description: A sophisticated phishing technique called CoPhish exploits Microsoft Copilot Studio to trick users into granting attackers unauthorized access to their Microsoft Entra ID accounts. Dubbed by Datadog Security Labs, this method uses customizable AI agents hosted on legitimate Microsoft domains to wrap traditional OAuth consent attacks, making them appear trustworthy and bypassing user suspicions.…
